description: One featured dish in a large tile among smaller ones.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Featured dishes as a bento: the first dish in a large tile (two by two) with its summary and a link to its
  page, the others in small tiles around it. Axes: feature (start, end), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type DishBentoProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    feature?: "start" | "end";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    feature = "start",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: DishBentoProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="star" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each dishes as d, i (d.id)}
        {#if (i === 0)}
          <Stack
            gap="4"
            class={cn(
              "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6 sm:col-span-2 lg:row-span-2",
              (((feature as string) === "end") ? "lg:col-start-3 lg:row-start-1" : "")
            )}
            data-testid="feature"
          >
            <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio="4/3" />
            <Badge variant="secondary" size="default" class="w-fit">
              {d.weight}
            </Badge>
            <Title as={3} size="2xl" weight="bold">
              {d.name}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {d.summary}
            </Text>
            <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="mt-auto">
              <Inline class="text-xl font-bold">
                {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
              </Inline>
              <Link href={urlOf((d.href ?? tpl("#/dish/{0}", d.id)))} variant="default">
                {labels.open}
                <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
              </Link>
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        {:else}
          <Stack gap="2" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="item">
            <MediaFrame alt={d.name} />
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {d.name}
            </Text>
            <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
              <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
                {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
              </Inline>
              <AddIcon label={tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)} />
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Box>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
